rationale: Houthis tighten Red Sea grip, threatening EU shipping routes and fuel costs; Israel destroys Hezbollah base escalates Middle East instability affecting energy security.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize Perim island Red Sea route
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis capture strategic Perim island on major shipping lane, tightening control over Bab al-Mandab Strait and threatening EU supply chains and fuel costs.

top_events.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
top_events.label: Israel destroys major Hezbollah underground base
top_events.summary: Powerful blast equivalent to magnitude 4.1 earthquake destroys Hezbollah infrastructure, escalating Middle East tensions with potential energy market impact for EU.

top_events.title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
top_events.label: Coach crash kills five in Swiss Alps
top_events.summary: Tourist coach carrying Dutch passengers overturns in southeastern Swiss Alps, killing five and injuring dozens in neighboring EU country.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea shipping

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea shipping
most_significant_event.summary: Capture of Mokha brings Houthis closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a critical waterway for EU trade and energy imports affecting Poland's supply chains.
